LanguageData.TheGravship.scenario.name: The Hellion
LanguageData.TheGravship.scenario.description: Your Hellion, a pre-war REPCONN aircraft, sits docked at the orbital relay. As your crew begins salvaging its systems, you realize this is no ordinary pre-war cache - it is a military tracking beacon. The relay crackles to life and broadcasts an intrusion alert to a command hub belonging to US Automated Aerospace Defense. Its orbital batteries are hunting you now, and they will eventually find you wherever you go. Note: This is a difficult scenario and is not recommended for new players.
